guidance_capabilities.note: Explicit engineering receive-fit declaration from this card's authored guidance. guidance: inertial midcourse with datalink updates, terminal active radar homing

warhead_kg.note: '12 kg de charge explosive': its explosive charge

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

explosive_kg.note: no source gives its charge: 37 % of its warhead, the median share of the game reference's charges (War Thunder's) - an estimate

gurney_kms.note: no source names its explosive: as PBXN-110, a modern HMX-based fill - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: Engineering estimate A_D = CD_simulated*S_geometry at neutral Mach .3. Inputs, dated model-specific searches and method limits are in hangar-vlm.simulation and the evidence catalog. Assumed one-sigma screening uncertainty is |A_D| in m2; its coverage probability is not established. Equipment drag error remains unknown; the table evidence basis is simulated.

mbda-meteor-identity.title: METEOR
mbda-meteor-identity.note: Manufacturer specification page; supplies mass, length and diameter only.

hangar-vlm.title: Shared Hangar aircraft VLM tables
hangar-vlm.note: Same base, rate and Mach data as the released JSBSim model; no equipment calibration claim.

method_sources: Katz and Plotkin, Low-Speed Aerodynamics, vortex lattice
Shared aero/model.py, tables.py and mach.py; engineering extensions are not equipment measurements

limitations: Generic AGARD-B geometry, not any of the 88 authored equipment models.
The publication pools facilities/model sizes and includes M0.8/M1.2 runs with the M0.77/M1.17 groups; no common Reynolds condition is supplied.
Body-normal force is derived as CN=CLf*cos(alpha)+CDf*sin(alpha), cancelling axial base-pressure force; reported CZ=-CN.
The 4% biconvex wing uses the existing shared section; its tiny specified leading-edge radius is not separately resolved.
Density/Reynolds and sting/wall interference differences remain. Residuals are not an equipment confidence interval.
No beta, dynamic derivative, powered flow or extreme-angle qualification follows from these conditions.

uncertainty.method: Coupled vortex-lattice/body/section/rate solution, common Mach extensions and common JSBSim tables; retained overrides are listed separately.
uncertainty.table_domain: Actual Mach/alpha/beta bounds are read from the generated product in hangar-vlm.simulation; no narrowing of the authored envelope.
uncertainty.uncertainty_basis: assumed engineering screening range, not measured equipment error or a probabilistic confidence interval
uncertainty.uncertainty_formula: Inside the generic comparison conditions: max(1,2*generic_NRMSE/100); outside them no finite equipment-error bound is established.
uncertainty.boundaries: Generic validation cannot identify equipment-specific separated flow, powered flow, Reynolds effects or extreme-angle errors; those remain unknown.
uncertainty.uncertainty_application: Assumed screening envelope only, not a measured model error or statistical bound. Applies to generic CZ/Cm comparison conditions; no finite equipment-error bound outside those conditions and no calibrated CD/CY/Cl/Cn uncertainty.
uncertainty.input_assumptions: Author-declared geometry and shared section/body correlations. Surface sections, sweep, twist, controls, body stations, mass/CG, analysis speed and all retained overrides are readable in aircraft/meteor/meteor.toml. Product extrema are generation coverage, not a validated physical domain.

nasa-ramjet-cycle-engineering.note: Reference for conservation equations only. No numeric input below is a measured Meteor cycle map; capture area is twice the existing authored 0.085 by 0.070 m intake estimate. Fuel reservoir and booster retain the original authored mass ledger.

simulation_model.calibration: Meteor is uncalibrated. Meteor executes the ducted-rocket V2 inlet/valve/combustor inventory model and ARH receiver on its 190 kg airframe. Booster and sustained air-breathing phases require altitude/Mach/inlet and starvation tests, rather than treating the authored sustained thrust as a solid-rocket motor. Retained card anchors: mass 190.0 kg (published; source mbda-meteor-identity; uncertainty 1.0), length 3.7 m (published; source mbda-meteor-identity; uncertainty 0.02), diameter 0.178 m (published; source mbda-meteor-identity; uncertainty 0.001), warhead 12.0 kg (published; source fr-meteor; uncertainty 2.0), explosive 4.43 kg (assumed; source unassigned; uncertainty 1.11). Current receiver rf_signal.v1; control fsim.control.load_feedback_cascade; propulsion fsim.propulsion.jsbsim_ducted_rocket.v2; fuze native.fuze.swept_path.v1; warhead native.warhead.zoned_case.v1. Manufacturer identity and published bulk mass do not calibrate inlet recovery, fuel metering, ram drag, combustor efficiency, seeker noise or the assumed explosive charge. Source classes and uncertainty records remain unchanged; assumed, derived and game-reference values are not promoted to equipment measurements. Per-model theory, parameter deltas and numerical method routes are in docs/research/sim-m03/component-methods/per-model-effects-components.json and per-model-six-components.json; the separate docs/research/sim-m03/calibration-ledger.json identifies the remaining equipment comparisons. Arithmetic or native scenario verification does not establish held-out accuracy. No admitted same-model independent baseline-to-new held-out calibration receipt is claimed; engineering completion continues through its own gates.
